scope: HITL-004 candidate-bound Approval terminal event/audit lifecycle on disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO.

observations.terminal_observation: Approval, denial, expiry, cancellation, and post-approval finalization retain safe Product events with independent durable audit/outbox correlations.

redaction: No IDs, credentials, descriptors, inputs, artifact bodies, DSNs, or endpoints are retained.
